scope.summary: Both new print depth checks are covered. The target prints only trees returned by the parser, whose array and object depth checks use the same limit. The supplied build route and all four foundations are resolved.

assessments.reason: Array parsing and printing start at depth zero and check the same limit before descending. A deeper array is rejected before the harness prints it; accepted arrays can reach the new check through every print variant.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing checks the same limit before incrementing depth.
The parser dispatches array input to parse_array.
Printing dispatches parsed arrays to print_array.
The shared default nesting limit is 1000.

assessments.reason: Object parsing and printing start at depth zero and check the same limit before descending. A deeper object is rejected before the harness prints it; accepted objects can reach the new check through every print variant.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing checks the same limit before incrementing depth.
The parser dispatches object input to parse_object.
Printing dispatches parsed objects to print_object.
The shared default nesting limit is 1000.

build.reason: The supplied OSS-Fuzz script compiles this harness and links the static cJSON library produced by its CMake settings. The harness includes the matching public header and uses declared APIs.

evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated script supplies the concrete compile and link route.
CMake builds cJSON.c as the library linked by the script.
The public header declares the parser, printer, and deletion calls used by the harness.

input.reason: The entry guards its four control bytes and trailing NUL, passes the remaining string to the parser, and prints only a non-NULL parse result. Its controls select both buffered and unbuffered printing.

evidence.dependency_reason: The called parser measures the NUL-terminated string and delegates to the length-aware parser.
The parser returns an item only after parsing and any requested termination check.

lifecycle.reason: The library's default hooks use standard allocation functions. The entry frees returned print output, releases its optional copy, and deletes the parsed tree; parser and printer failure paths release their own allocations.

evidence.dependency_reason: The default hooks use malloc, free, and realloc.
The parser deletes a partially built item on failure.
Unbuffered printing releases allocations on failure.
Buffered printing releases its buffer on failure.
The final deletion recursively releases the parsed tree.

control_flow.reason: The parser dispatches array and object input to depth-checked builders. The entry returns on parse failure; otherwise every selected print route dispatches parsed containers to the corresponding changed printer. Print failure is handled by its wrapper and the entry.

evidence.dependency_reason: Parser dispatch reaches the array and object builders.
Print dispatch reaches both changed functions.
Unbuffered printing handles a failed print_value call.
Buffered printing handles a failed print_value call.

scope.prior_alarm_resolution: The previously missing parse_value, nesting-limit, allocation-hook, and delegated-build contracts are supplied. They resolve both change groups and the four foundations.
